_meta.description: Request-URL -> vendor map for Study 3 (Shopify consent). Built by build_vendor_endpoints.py from the Study 2 vendor table plus observed endpoints.
_meta.matching: lower-case hostname; first entry whose host_regex (Python re.search) matches and whose path_regex (if not null) matches the URL path. beacon_path_regex/library_path_regex refine request kind; anything that is neither is counted as a beacon (Study 2 convention).
_meta.is_advertising: true for ad platforms, retargeting/ID networks and ad measurement (Study 2 group "ad"); false for analytics, tag managers, email/SMS marketing, affiliate, attribution and Shopify first-party.
_meta.figure_color_group: FIGURE_PLAN.md vendor colour group (Google, TikTok, Meta, Pinterest, Snap, Microsoft, Reddit/other); null = not an ad vendor in figures.

shopify_web_pixels_urls.notes: Observed on c005.store.example in Study 2 evidence and in the WPM bundle (hash c8540278we853e1abpb62b2c4amde256306, 2026-09-25). Requests made by a STRICT pixel (e.g. analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/shopify.js and /api/v2/shopify_pixel) are issued from a dedicated web worker; Playwright reports them with resource type "other"/"fetch" and, in Study 2 capture.js, frame "main" (request.frame() did not throw). Attribute origin by (i) page.on("worker") URLs, (ii) CDP Network.requestWillBeSent initiator / Target info, or (iii) the fact that the vendor library was requested with resource type "other" right after the matching worker bootstrap.

vendors.worker_marker: library analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/shopify.js requested with Playwright resource type "other" = loaded inside the Shopify STRICT web worker (101 Study 2 loads); resource type "script" = classic main-thread pixel.

shopify_app_pixel.note: Google & YouTube app (one pixel sends Google Ads, GA4 and Merchant Center tags); declares no privacy purposes, so the WPM never withholds it; consent is signalled only through Consent Mode parameters (gcs/gcd/npa).

vendors.display_name: Shopify first-party telemetry / Shop Pay (not a third-party ad vendor)
